reason: The cited evidence shows that AlCoCrFeNi coatings oxidize at 650–1000 °C (E1) and that oxidative wear occurs (E3), but none of the passages demonstrate that increasing Al/Cr content enhances oxide layer formation, that the oxide is self-lubricating, or that it reduces friction and wear compared to a baseline. The key mechanistic premises are unsupported by the cited evidence.
